metadata.name: workspace-analyze-hero
metadata.description: Stage-5 Analyze journey driving the analysis surface end-to-end against the real backend: navigates to /workspace, switches to Analyze mode, and asserts the Analyze panel composes with the one-tap analysis actions discovered from AnalysisService.ListAnalysisOperations (Inspect/probe, Extract text/ocr, Safety check/nsfw_classify). It then loads an image and runs the default op (probe) — and because probe is the pure-Go, no-model analysis op (unlike the model-backed ocr/nsfw_classify), the run resolves SYNCHRONOUSLY to a real metadata result with NO install gate. Asserting the probe result panel renders proves the full discovery -> sync analyze edge (POST /api/v1/analysis/probe) -> AnalyzeResponse oneof parse -> structured-result render wiring works against the live API. A broken analysis-discovery RPC, an Analyze panel that fails to compose, a regressed multipart analyze edge, or a result that never renders all fail here. The model-backed ocr/nsfw_classify ops (which need an opt-in model absent in CI) surface the install gate instead — that post-install path + the on-canvas OCR detection boxes are the ATTENDED acceptance gate; the lifecycle + parsing are unit-covered by api/analysis.test, useAnalyze.test, and Workspace.analyze.test.

assert.failure_message: The Inspect/probe action did not render — AnalysisService.ListAnalysisOperations discovery regressed.
The Extract-text/ocr action did not render — AnalysisService.ListAnalysisOperations discovery regressed.

evaluate.expression: (() => { const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = 240; c.height = 160; const g = c.getContext('2d'); g.fillStyle = '#3b6ea5'; g.fillRect(0, 0, 240, 160); g.fillStyle = '#f0c419'; g.fillRect(40, 30, 160, 100); return new Promise((resolve) => { c.toBlob((blob) => { const file = new File([blob], 'sample.png', { type: 'image/png' }); const input = document.querySelector('[data-testid="workspace-file-input"]'); const dt = new DataTransfer(); dt.items.add(file); input.files = dt.files; input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); resolve('loaded'); }, 'image/png'); }); })()
